issues.quote: Then at twenty-one minutes past ten by my watch, someone came quickly down. I did not see who that was either. I only heard the feet on the stairs." / "Did you hear anything else before the next thing?" / "...Then, at eighteen minutes past ten by my watch, I heard a thump on the floor right above me, in the atelier.
issues.fact: F4 says the descent at 10:21 came after the 10:15 ascent and that the thump at 10:18 came before the 10:21 descent (the sheet orders the thump between the two stair movements). The fact sheet's 'Before the thump' only applies to the 10:15 ascent.
issues.misreading: The transcript narrates the 10:21 descent first, then has Matthey ask about 'anything else before the next thing', then gives the thump with 'Then, at eighteen minutes past ten'. A careful solver would read the thump as happening after the descent (10:21), reversing the true order of 10:18 thump and 10:21 descent and changing who could have been on the stairs at the moment of the thump.
